content: Homelab GitOps platforms on k3s+ArgoCD converge on a standard feature set: ArgoCD app-of-apps or ApplicationSet for onboarding, cert-manager + external-dns (or equivalent) for automated TLS/DNS, sealed-secrets/SOPS/external-secrets for secrets, Renovate or ArgoCD Image Updater for image bumps, and the ArgoCD UI plus a homepage-style dashboard for visibility. Many public reference repos (cterence/homelab-gitops, pablodelarco/kubernetes-homelab, loeken/homelab, adavarski/homelab) follow this pattern. Scaffolding reduces new-service onboarding to image+port choices.
